headline: Last session: Bears take charge as Sensex plunges 989 points and Nifty slips below 25,650

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: IT stocks and banking heavyweights dragged down the equity benchmarks in the previous session.
Profit booking took over following a recent multi-day market rally.
Weakness in key constituents like HDFC Bank led the broader market decline.
Shifting foreign fund inflows and mixed international cues weighed on sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex tumbled 989 points while Nifty closed below 25,650 in the last trading session.
HDFC Bank and IT stocks were major drags on the Sensex and Nifty performance.
Tata Sons filed caveats in the Bombay High Court and Supreme Court ahead of its November 30 board meet.
Bisleri requested FSSAI to review conflicting test results regarding a sample batch from West Bengal.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices suffered steep losses with Sensex plunging 989 points and Nifty closing below 25,650. Heavy selling in IT sector stocks and HDFC Bank pulled the market down after recent sessions of gains. The Indian stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 30 November.
